title: SR Path Not Installing in Forwarding Table
symptoms: Segment Routing is enabled on all routers
The SRGB is configured but SIDs are not being advertised
MPLS forwarding table has no SR entries
rootCause: Segment Routing is enabled globally under the IGP, but the prefix-SID is missing on the loopback interface. Without a prefix-SID, the router does not advertise an MPLS label for its prefix, breaking SR forwarding.

steps.prompt: Which command shows whether SR is enabled under IS-IS?
steps.hint: Look for 'segment-routing mpls' under the IS-IS process.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the SRGB and prefix-SID configuration?
steps.hint: Verify the SRGB range and that loopback has a prefix-SID.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the IS-IS database with SR extensions?
steps.hint: Look for SR sub-TLVs advertising prefix-SIDs.
